newsitem.title: USA: Daw says industry downturn leads to cuts.
newsitem.headline: Daw says industry downturn leads to cuts.

text.p: Daw Technologies Inc said on Monday that a dismal outlook on current market conditions in the semiconductor industry has led it to believe it may be difficult to sustain the same level of growth and profitability it has posted in recent quarters.
Given the current market conditions, the company said it has taken steps to cut costs, including reducing its workforce by five percent in late September.
Nevertheless, Daw Technologies said it continues to "feel very good" about the long-term growth.

"The changes that are taking place in the industry should result in new applications and greater demand for semiconductors which could lead to new facilities and expanded capital expenditures," Chairman and Chief Executive Ronald Daw said in a statement.

For the third quarter, the company reported net income of $1.02 million, or $0.08 per share, on revenues of $30.01 million. In the prior year's third quarter, the company reported net income of $242,000, or $0.02 per share, on revenues of $17.40 million.
